headline: Brest and Nice, one point apart, on a night for Eric Roy
summary: Brest host Nice in Ligue 1 on Friday, four months after the death of Eric Roy, who coached both clubs; France Bleu reports both will pay tribute. Only one point separates them in mid-table — Brest 10th on 9, Nice 13th on 8. Nice lost 2-1 at Lyon on Sunday, a stoppage-time equaliser ruled out. Brest beat Angers 5-1 in their last home game, though Raphaël Le Guen is out with a broken leg after 450 minutes this season. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Brest are favourites at 42.2%, rated 0.25 of a goal better, and the goals line sits at 2.75 with over at 50%.
read: Brest are narrow home favourites at 42.2%, with the handicap at just -0.25 and only one point separating the sides in mid-table. Both arrive off narrow results — Brest's 1-1 at Lille, Nice's 2-1 defeat at Lyon — and the market sees a close game of about two and a half goals where both teams are more likely than not to score.

facts.fact: Brest are the market's favourites at 42.2% to win at home.
facts.meaning: The handicap is only -0.25, so the market rates Brest a quarter of a goal the better side — favourite, but a close game.

facts.fact: Brest are 10th on 9 points, Nice 13th on 8 — one point between them after seven rounds.
facts.meaning: A win for either side moves them clear into the top half; defeat leaves Nice in the bottom third.

facts.fact: Nice lost 2-1 at Lyon on Sunday, with a stoppage-time equaliser ruled out for centimetres and Keito Nakamura sent off on 70 minutes.
facts.meaning: Nice arrive off an away defeat they could easily have drawn.

facts.fact: Friday's match comes four months after the death of Eric Roy, who coached both Brest and Nice, and both clubs will pay tribute to him.
facts.meaning: An emotional night at the Stade Francis-Le Blé, on a fixture with a shared history.

facts.fact: The market splits Over and Under 2.75 goals at 50.0% each.
facts.meaning: Two or three goals is the expected shape of this game — a normal, compact Ligue 1 night.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 59.9% by the seven bookmakers offering it.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that both sides find the net on Friday.

facts.fact: Brest beat Angers 5-1 at home on 10 October.
facts.meaning: The one day this season Brest's attack ran riot at home — they lost their other home game to PSG.

facts.fact: Brest are without defender Raphaël Le Guen, who has 450 minutes in five league games this season, through a broken leg.
facts.meaning: He is Brest's most-used absentee; the coach says only he and Chardonnet should miss out.

sources.fact: Julien Lachuer said only Brendan Chardonnet and Raphaël Le Guen should miss the visit of Nice through injury.
Giovani Versini stopped training on Wednesday and is doubtful for Nice, though his coach Julien Lachuer has not fully ruled him out of the squad.
Versini returned to training and Baldé is said to be reassuring ahead of the Nice match.
Olivier Pantaloni wants to neutralise Brest striker Ludovic Ajorque, whose statistics are highlighted as a threat.
Brest drew 1-1 at Lille on Saturday, again pairing Gautier Lloris and Lucas Tousart in central defence.
Brest were sanctioned by the LFP disciplinary commission on Wednesday 21 October, with the details of the sanction listed by the outlet.
Nice lost 2-1 at Lyon on Sunday in Ligue 1's 7th round and remain 13th in the table.
Nice had a goal by Wahi ruled out for a matter of centimetres in stoppage time at Lyon.
